name: bible-coder
description: A short Bible reading under your agent's final answer when a task finishes, from your own Bibe Code reading plan. Needs the bible-coder CLI; silent until you run bible-coder setup --source plugin.

interface.longDescription: When Codex finishes a task, Bibe Code shows one short Bible reading under the final answer and moves your reading plan forward. Free WEB and KJV text comes bundled with the bible-coder CLI. The verses never enter the model's context, and a finished plan gets one quiet line instead. The plugin stays silent until you run bible-coder setup --source plugin --client codex.
defaultPrompt: Make me a reading plan for Romans
